## Payroll Gap 
```{r}
payroll_gap <- payroll_with_standings %>%
  group_by(league, year) %>%
  summarize(
    payroll_gap = max(amount) - min(amount),
    win_gap = max(W) - min(W),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    payroll_with_standings %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarize(
        league = "Overall",
        payroll_gap = max(amount) - min(amount),
        win_gap = max(W) - min(W),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_group = ifelse(year < 2020, "before_2020", "after_2020")
  )

payroll_gap_plot <- ggplot(payroll_gap, aes(x = year, group = league)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = payroll_gap, color = league)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = payroll_gap, color = league), linetype = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2024) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e6, suffix = "M")) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Season") +
  ylab("Payroll Gap") +
  labs(color = "League") +
  ggtitle("League Payroll Gap by Season") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

win_gap_plot <- ggplot(payroll_gap, aes(x = year, group = league)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = win_gap, color = league)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = win_gap, color = league), linetype = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2024) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e6, suffix = "M")) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Season") +
  ylab("Win Gap") +
  labs(color = "League") +
  ggtitle("League Win Gap by Season") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

payroll_win_gap <- ggarrange(payroll_gap_plot, win_gap_plot,
                             common.legend = TRUE, legend="bottom")

ggsave("figures/payroll_win_gap.png", 
       payroll_win_gap,
       width = 8, height = 4, units = "in")
```

## Min, Avg, Max Payroll 
```{r}
team_payroll_by_year <- payroll_with_standings %>% group_by(league, year) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_team_payroll = mean(amount), 
    max_team_payroll = max(amount), 
    min_team_payroll = min(amount), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% bind_rows(
    payroll_with_standings %>% 
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarize(
        league = "Overall", 
        avg_team_payroll = mean(amount), 
        max_team_payroll = max(amount), 
        min_team_payroll = min(amount), 
        .groups = "drop"
        )
  ) %>% pivot_longer(
    cols = c(avg_team_payroll, max_team_payroll, min_team_payroll), 
    names_to = "payroll_type",  
    values_to = "payroll_value" 
  ) %>% mutate(
    gap_group = ifelse(year < 2020, "before_2020", "after_2020")
  )

league_payroll_by_season <- ggplot(team_payroll_by_year, aes(x = year, 
                                 group = interaction(league, payroll_type))) +
  geom_point(aes(y = payroll_value, color = payroll_type)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = payroll_value, color = payroll_type, linetype = league)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +  
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted")) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2024) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e6, suffix = "M")) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Season") +
  ylab("Team Payroll") +
  labs(color = "", linetype = "League") +
  ggtitle("League Payroll by Season") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

ggsave("figures/league_payroll_by_season.png", 
       league_payroll_by_season,
```

# Player Status 
```{r}
# Summarize status info and other relevant info for each team each year 
status_summary <- roster_payroll_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(status_simple) &
           !is.na(payroll_salary_adjusted)) %>%
  group_by(team_id, year, status_simple) %>%
  summarize(
    num_players = n(),
    min_salary = min(payroll_salary_adjusted, na.rm = T),
    max_salary = max(payroll_salary_adjusted, na.rm = T),
    avg_salary = mean(payroll_salary_adjusted, na.rm = T),
    total_payroll = sum(payroll_salary_adjusted, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    payroll_with_standings %>% select(amount, year_end_40_man, rank, team_id, year, league, division, market_size, W, W.L., win_variability),
    by = join_by(team_id, year)
  ) %>%
  rename(total_payroll_amount = amount,
         total_payroll_rank = rank) %>%
  mutate(status_simple = factor(
    status_simple,
    levels = c("Pre-Arbitration", "Arbitration", "Veteran")
  ))
```

## Win variance
```{r}
status_summary_wide <- status_summary %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = status_simple, 
              values_from = c(num_players, min_salary, max_salary, avg_salary, total_payroll), 
              names_glue = "{status_simple}_{.value}") %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_lower(str_replace_all(., "-", "_"))) %>%
  mutate(
    market_size_cat = case_when(
      market_size >= 5e6 ~ "large", 
      market_size < 5e6 & market_size >= 2.5e6 ~ "mid", 
      market_size < 2.5e6 ~ "small"
    ), 
    market_size_cat = factor(market_size_cat, levels = c("small", "mid", "large")), 
    total_players = veteran_num_players + arbitration_num_players + pre_arbitration_num_players
  )

status_payroll_summary <- status_summary_wide %>% 
  filter(year != 2020) %>% 
  group_by(team_id) %>%
  summarize(
    win_sd = sd(w), 
    total_payroll = sum(total_payroll_amount), 
    avg_payroll = mean(total_payroll_amount), 
    total_veteran_payroll = sum(veteran_total_payroll), 
    avg_veteran_payroll = mean(veteran_total_payroll), 
    total_arbitration_payroll = sum(arbitration_total_payroll), 
    avg_arbitration_payroll = mean(arbitration_total_payroll), 
    total_pre_arbitration_payroll = sum(pre_arbitration_total_payroll), 
    avg_pre_arbitration_payroll = mean(pre_arbitration_total_payroll), 
    market_size_cat = first(market_size_cat)
  )
  

ggplot(status_payroll_summary, aes(x = avg_payroll, y = win_sd, color=market_size_cat)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = team_id), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e6, suffix = "M")) +
  ylim(0, max(status_payroll_summary$win_sd)) + 
  xlab("Average Total Payroll Each Season") + 
  ylab("Wins") + 
  theme_bw()

ggplot(status_payroll_summary, aes(x = avg_veteran_payroll, y = win_sd, color=market_size_cat)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = team_id), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e9, suffix = "B")) +
  ylim(0, max(status_payroll_summary$win_sd)) + 
  xlab("Average Total Veteran Payroll Each Season") + 
  ylab("Wins") + 
  theme_bw()

ggplot(status_payroll_summary, aes(x = avg_arbitration_payroll, y = win_sd, color=market_size_cat)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = team_id), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e9, suffix = "B")) +
  ylim(0, max(status_payroll_summary$win_sd)) + 
  xlab("Average Total Arbitration Payroll Each Season") + 
  ylab("Wins") + 
  theme_bw()


ggplot(status_payroll_summary, aes(x = avg_pre_arbitration_payroll, y = win_sd, color=market_size_cat)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text(aes(label = team_id), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(scale = 1/1e6, suffix = "M")) +
  ylim(0, max(status_payroll_summary$win_sd)) + 
  xlab("Average Total Pre-Arbitration Payroll Each Season") + 
  ylab("Wins") + 
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}

    n_distinct(roster_payroll_data %>% select(Name, DoB)))

top_contracts <- roster_payroll_data %>% filter(!is.na(status_simple)) %>% 
  group_by(status_simple) %>% slice_max(payroll_salary_adjusted, n = 10) %>% 
  select(Name, Age, G, year, team_id, position, payroll_salary_adjusted, status_simple)

  group_by(status_simple) %>% slice_min(payroll_salary_adjusted, n = 10) %>% 
  select(Name, Age, G, year, team_id, position, payroll_salary_adjusted, status_simple)

top_contract_yearly <- roster_payroll_data %>% group_by(year) %>% slice_max(payroll_salary_adjusted, n=3) %>% 
  select(Name, Age, G, year, team_id, position, payroll_salary_adjusted, status_simple)

```

```{r}
format_salary <- function(value) {
  ifelse(value >= 1e6, paste0(round(value / 1e6, 2), "M"),
         ifelse(value >= 1e3, paste0(round(value / 1e3, 1), "K"), as.character(value)))
}

# Select columns to summarize
cols_to_summarize <- c("payroll_salary_adjusted", "G")

# Convert summary output into a data frame
summary_list <- lapply(roster_payroll_data[cols_to_summarize], summary)

# Convert list to a data frame
summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(summary_df) <- c("Column", "Min", "1st_Quartile", "Median", "Mean", "3rd_Quartile", "Max", "Num_NA")

# Apply formatting to salary column
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(Min, `1st_Quartile`, Median, Mean, `3rd_Quartile`, Max, Num_NA), 
                ~ if_else(Column == "payroll_salary_adjusted", format_salary(as.numeric(.)), as.character(.))))

# Print formatted summary
print(summary_df)

```
```{r}
# Function to format salary values in K or M
format_salary <- function(value) {
  ifelse(value >= 1e6, paste0(round(value / 1e6, 2), "M"),
         ifelse(value >= 1e3, paste0(round(value / 1e3, 1), "K"), as.character(value)))
}

# Select columns to summarize
cols_to_summarize <- c("payroll_salary_adjusted", "Age", "G")

# Apply summary() and extract the result as a list
summary_list <- lapply(roster_payroll_data[cols_to_summarize], summary)

# Convert list to a data frame
summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Column")

# Rename columns (handling possible NA column variations)
colnames(summary_df) <- c("Column", "Min", "1st_Quartile", "Median", "Mean", "3rd_Quartile", "Max", "NA_Count")

# Ensure NA_Count exists (if no NAs in dataset, summary() may not include this column)
if (!"NA_Count" %in% colnames(summary_df)) {
  summary_df$NA_Count <- 0
}

# Apply formatting to salary column and rounding to others
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(Min, `1st_Quartile`, Median, Mean, `3rd_Quartile`, Max), 
                ~ if_else(Column == "payroll_salary_adjusted", 
                          sapply(as.numeric(.), format_salary), 
                          as.character(round(as.numeric(.), 2)))))  # Round non-salary values

# Convert NA_Count to integer
summary_df$NA_Count <- as.integer(summary_df$NA_Count)

# Print formatted summary
print(summary_df)


```
```{r}
format_millions <- function(value) {
  ifelse(is.na(value), NA, paste0(round(value / 1e6, 2), "M"))
}

# Apply summary() and extract the result as a list
summary_list <- lapply(status_summary_wide %>% select(where(is.numeric)), summary)

# Convert list to a data frame
summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Column")

# Rename columns (handling possible NA column variations)
colnames(summary_df) <- c("Column", "Min", "1st_Quartile", "Median", "Mean", "3rd_Quartile", "Max")

# Apply formatting to salary column and rounding to others
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(Min, `1st_Quartile`, Median, Mean, `3rd_Quartile`, Max), 
                ~ if_else(str_detect(Column, "payroll"), 
                          sapply(as.numeric(.), format_millions), 
                          as.character(round(as.numeric(.), 2)))))

# Print formatted summary
print(summary_df)

```

```{r}
  )
```
